name: PA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+40 partisan lean of this Philadelphia-based district
Independent rival Dennis Mahoney raised only about $11,000 with no outside support
Chris Rabb's $1.3 million in primary fundraising and $1.6 million in outside support signal a strong Democratic standard-bearer
Open seat after Dwight Evans's retirement, but no meaningful general-election opposition
model.rationale: The district's D+40 lean and a general-election rival who has raised roughly $11,000 make the Democratic nominee an overwhelming favorite; the competitive phase of this race was the Democratic primary, not the general. Prediction markets price the Democratic side near 97%, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: A late infusion of outside money for Mahoney or an unusually low-turnout general election could narrow the margin somewhat, though the outcome itself is unlikely to be in doubt.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Dwight Evans (D) is not on the ballot.
Dennis Mahoney is an independent standing in for the Republican side.

overview:
PA-03 is among the most Democratic-leaning House districts in the country, and Dwight Evans's retirement turns this into an open-seat contest rather than a true battle. Chris Rabb emerged from a competitive and expensive Democratic primary that functioned as the real election; he raised about $1.3 million and drew more than $1.5 million in outside support, though he enters the general election with limited cash on hand. His only rival, independent Dennis Mahoney, has raised roughly $11,000 and shows no outside backing.

With no public polls and no expert ratings, the outlook rests on district fundamentals and market pricing. Prediction markets put Democratic odds near 97%, and past results in this seat have featured enormous Democratic margins. The realistic question is the size of the victory margin, not which party wins the seat.
